items: 【Latest Android 16 Tablet with AI-Ready Performance】Discover a smarter 10-inch tablet, powered by pure Android 16 OS and a Tiger T7200 powerful octa-core processor. With Gemini AI as your co-pilot, go from summarizing meetings to drafting emails effortlessly. Boost your productivity while enjoying seamless multitasking and apps like TikTok and Netflix.

【120Hz Eye-Care Display & Immersive Sound】Experience stunning visuals on this 10-inch Android tablet computer. Its 120Hz TDDI In-Cell IPS display offers smooth gaming and incredibly vibrant video. With eye-comfort technology, it's the perfect tablet for students, adults, and kids. Combined with Widevine L1 HD certification and stereo speakers, dive into a cinematic experience on Netflix, YouTube, and Disney+—the ultimate entertainment tablet.

【20GB RAM + 64GB ROM + 2TB Expandable】 Never worry about speed or space again. With up to 20GB of RAM (4GB physical + 16GB expansion), this high-performance Android tablet ensures flawless multitasking and buttery-smooth performance for gaming and demanding apps. The 64GB internal storage is expandable to 2TB via microSD (card not included), creating a portable library for all your HD movies, music, and photos—the ultimate tablet for work and play.

【All-Day 6000mAh Battery & Advanced Connectivity】Power through your day with this 10-inch Android tablet. The large-capacity battery delivers up to 10 hours of mixed use—perfect for streaming, browsing, and reading. Stay perfectly connected with dual-band Wi-Fi for crystal-clear Zoom calls and Bluetooth 5.0 to pair keyboards, controllers, and earbuds. Your ideal tablet for students, home entertainment, and mobile productivity.

【Family Tablet with GPS for Car & Kids】This versatile Android tablet 10 inch is your perfect car companion with Android Auto support and built-in GPS navigation. As a secure kids tablet, enhanced parental controls let you manage screen time, filter content, and protect privacy—giving you complete peace of mind.

【Complete Set with Case & Reliable Support】Your tablet bundle includes everything to start immediately: the 10-inch Android tablet, a protective case, charger, USB-C cable, and manual—ready to use right out of the box.This complete package is gift-ready for students and families. Backed by reliable customer support, we ensure your complete satisfaction with prompt assistance. Should you have any questions, visit your order page and click "Contact Seller" to reach us directly. We aim to respond within 24 hours.
